The manifest — the strip and the stage

annotations.text: Read left to right: the cover, then every open issue with its verdict, then the eight budget rules, then the shipped app measured against the drawing. Page 2 holds the surfaces.
Blue Mantis Divers, Thursday August 27, 2026. Every name is invented. Reef in Geist on the staff boards; the demo shop's green and Bricolage Grotesque on the diver's.
The manifest board carries no drawing, no coral and no motion. The stage strip and the catch-up strip are words on the tideline, nothing else.
The shipped page is 5,782px before the form. This one is 2,140px. Everything cut is one tap away, opened in place.
